messages:
maria: Heads-up — p99 for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 spiked from ~180ms -> ~1.2s around 2025-08-11 10:45 UTC. p95 also elevated. Customers are starting to open tickets. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/eu-west/p99-dashboard :rotating_light:

alex: I can see the spike. coalescer_hold_ms and batch_fill_time both jumped. queue_depth shows a pattern: a lot of tiny requests are getting stuck behind occasional very large requests (>=1k tokens) — classic head-of-line blocking in the continuous coalescer.

liam: Repro I ran on canary so we can be confident it's the batching policy not auth/billing:
1) run blended load (85% small ~30 tokens + 15% large ~1200 tokens) at ~120 rps
2) watch coalescer_hold_ms, batch_fill_time, and per-request latency histogram

Example quick repro script (bash):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"short prompt","max_tokens":16}' &
  if (( i % 13 == 0 )); then
    curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"long prompt ...","max_tokens":1200}'
  fi
 done
```

alex: On canary I applied a quick config tweak: lower coalescer_grace_window_ms 12 -> 5, max_batch_size 128 -> 64, and enabled eager_flush_for_small_prompts=true. p99 dropped from ~1.2s back to ~200-300ms. Observed tradeoff: slight bump in per-token cost (~3%) because smaller batches.

maria: Sounds promising. Can we hotpatch the affected pool only (eu-west-1, pool id gp-23)? Any tenant isolation or rollback gotchas?

liam: Yes — gp-23 is the impacted GPU pool. The config is dynamic per-pool so we can roll the change to gp-23 only. Rollout plan in the runbook:
- call POST /internal/configs/pools/gp-23 with new values
- gradually rollout to hosts (one AZ at a time)
- watch p95/p99, coalescer_hold_ms, queue_depth, and cost-rate

jen: +1 to targeted rollout. Also putting a temporary rate cap on the top offending tenant (acme-corp) while we patch to reduce noise.

deploy-bot: Started config rollout to pool gp-23 (eu-west-1) at 2025-08-11T10:52:58Z — 1/3 hosts updated.

maria: Good. Post the rollback steps here if any 5xx spikes or auth flaps appear.

alex: Rollback steps:
- revert gp-23 config to previous coalescer_grace_window_ms and max_batch_size via the same /internal/configs endpoint
- disable eager_flush_for_small_prompts if enabled
If 503s or auth errors rise after the change, revert immediately and open an incident.

liam: Follow-ups to schedule:
- add coalescer_hold_time_p90 metric and an alert on sudden increases
- experiment: automatic detection of mixed long/short workload to switch the pool into "per-request flush" mode when heavy long-request mix is present
- add a lightweight canary that mixes requests to catch head-of-line regressions earlier

maria: Thanks team — I'll update the support ticket with repro steps and the mitigation. Monitoring looks stable for the first two hosts. :white_check_mark:
